text_markup: Some events have the subtype {subtype:current}. As part of their abilities, {subtype:current} events prevent themselves from being trashed until another {subtype:current} operation or event is played or the Corp scores an agenda. When one of these occurs, the active {subtype:current} is trashed during the next checkpoint. See {ref:rule_play_not_trashed_until}.
text_plain: Some events have the subtype current. As part of their abilities, current events prevent themselves from being trashed until another current operation or event is played or the Corp scores an agenda. When one of these occurs, the active current is trashed during the next checkpoint. See rule 8.6.6c.
